chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Safwan, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: For every month, an Umrah.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about performing Umrah every month?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) emphasis on the spiritual merit of frequent Umrah, distinguishing it from the obligatory Hajj by establishing its permissibility and virtue in every month. Within Shia jurisprudence, this supports the view that while Hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime obligation, Umrah can be performed repeatedly to maintain spiritual purity and devotion. The hadith underscores the continuous nature of worship in Shia tradition, encouraging believers to seek nearness to Allah through regular pilgrimage to the Kaaba.
